title: podonosma orientalis
intro: Podonosma orientalis, commonly known as Indian spikenard or Valerian of the East, is a plant species belonging to the Valerianaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to promote relaxation, reduce anxiety, and improve sleep quality, thus providing several health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Podonosma orientalis are attributed to its sedative and anti-anxiety properties, which are achieved through its ability to modulate the nervous system. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include valerenic acid, isovaleric acid, and valeranone, which are found in its roots and leaves.
